newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION - Three Bledisloe Cup tests set for 1997.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - Three Bledisloe Cup tests set for 1997.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Jan 15 - New Zealand and Australia will play for the Bledisloe Cup in three rugby tests this winter, NZPA reports.

The New Zealand Rugby Football Union's (NZRFU) confirmed test dates for 1997 show the cup, currently held by the All Blacks, will be played for at Christchurch on July 5, Melbourne in a night test on July 26, and then Dunedin on August 16.
The latter two test matches will double as part of the tri series which also involves South Africa.
The NZRFU and the Australian Rugby Football Union have yet to decide whether or not the Bledisloe Cup will be up for grabs in each of the three tests, or played for over the series.

The All Blacks begin their eight-match international season against Fiji in a night test at North Harbour's new Albany stadium on June 14 before facing Argentina in Wellington on June 21 and then playing under lights at Hamilton on June 28.
Following the Bledisloe Cup test at Lancaster Park, they kick off the tri series against South Africa in Pretoria on July 19 before travelling to Melbourne.
They wrap up the season with home tests against South Africa in Auckland on August 9 and against Australia in Dunedin.
Dates for the end-of-year tour to Wales and England have yet to be confirmed.

June 14 v Fiji, Albany, Auckland (night); June 21 v Argentina, Wellington; June 28 v Argentina, Hamilton (night); July 5 v Australia (Bledisloe Cup), Christchurch; July 19 v South Africa (tri series), Pretoria; July 26 v Australia (Bledisloe Cup/tri series), Melbourne (night); August 9 v South Africa (tri series), Auckland; August 16 v Australia (tri series/Bledisloe Cup), Dunedin.
